name: Grand Hotel Majestic gia Baglioni
positioning: Historic 18th-century palazzo hotel on Via dell'Indipendenza in Bologna, officially the Grand Hotel Majestic 'già Baglioni', a Leading Hotels of the World member since 1990
best_for: Travelers who want a historic palazzo base in central Bologna
Food and wine lovers interested in pasta-making classes and sommelier tastings

facts.text: The hotel is a historic palazzo dating back to the 18th century.
The hotel has been a member of The Leading Hotels of the World since 1990.
The hotel is at Via dell'Indipendenza 8 in Bologna.
The hotel's historic wine cellar is known today as Enoteca Morandi, in homage to the Bolognese painter Giorgio Morandi.
The Enoteca Wine Bar hosts wine and food tastings with the hotel's sommelier.
Classic and Superior rooms are furnished in traditional Venetian style.
The Art Deco Terrace Suite is unique in the hotel in its style.
The hotel has seven meeting rooms: three historic rooms in Venetian style with 16th-century decorations and chests, and four modern rooms; all have natural light.
The hotel offers cooking classes in handmade fresh pasta, guided by the hotel's chef.

highlights.text: The vaulted ceiling of the I Carracci restaurant is entirely frescoed by the school of the Carracci brothers.
The Terrazza Torre and Terrazza Foyer are on the piano nobile, reserved for the suites; the Terrazza Torre overlooks Palazzo Fava.
The Café Marinetti floor was made by Tuscan artisans in Art Deco style using Statuario, Nero Marquinia and Giallo Siena marbles from Carrara.
The Lost Perfume experience explores a historic fragrance born in 1827, beginning inside the hotel.

considerations.text: The terraces can be booked for drinks or light snacks, with a fee for the dedicated service.
WhataHotel notes the city-center setting means limited on-site outdoor leisure space, such as a pool or large gardens.
WhataHotel notes rates reflect the hotel's five-star heritage positioning.
